name: Shapes & Seasons Farm
description: A low-poly farm collection with buildings, fencing, crops, animals and working animation clips.
licenseScope: CC0-1.0 covers authored asset content only, to the extent of the owner’s rights. Kiln, the scene code, Three.js, BVH, Field Grass and other components retain their own licenses.

downloads.compatibility: Standard glTF 2.0 with Three.js consumer checks recorded. Godot, Unity, Unreal, Roblox, USDZ and s&box conversion are not qualified by this download.

contents: Pinned rebuild kit and authoring metadata
downloads.compatibility: The image-free rebuild needs no provider or GPU service. It was verified in a fresh extraction of the exact master on Windows Node v24.20.0, which is not a cross-platform guarantee.

contents: Runnable scene and editable scene modules
downloads.compatibility: WebGPU with WebGL2 fallback. A reference application, not a complete farming game or physics engine; see metadata/performance-and-devices.md for tested configurations and limits.

poster.alt: Farm scene, wide elevated view: watermill and stream at top, red barn, cream farmhouse with porch, tractor and trailer, fenced paddocks with sheep, wheat field, low-poly woodland. Landscape.
poster.revisionQualification: Scene view from r33. Layout and exterior are unchanged; it was not re-captured for r34. Farmhouse windows may differ at pixel level.

scene.description: The interactive site scene is being rebuilt in React Three Fiber. The scene download contains the current runnable version.

floorRevision.review: Wood floor verified: 12 downward interior rays land on Mesh_InteriorFloor (Farm honey wood) at y 0.38 instead of the stone foundation top at 0.40. Fourteen meshes, all transforms and all materials unchanged; Mesh_ShellStone re-tessellated around the floor with 132 exterior probes identical before/after; bounds unchanged. Material-faithful GPU interior and hero views before/after. Fresh editable import/rebuild matches the exact saved artifact. Gemini 3.8 Flash High via agy refined the Opus 5.5 house, High requested; owner accepted the edit on 29 September 2026.
limits: Portable wood material from the existing Farm honey-wood record; no new texture maps.
GPU and runtime visual checks do not qualify performance while this PC is under competing load.
Pack delivery archives and the proving scene still carry the glazed revision until they are rebuilt.

before.alt: Farmhouse interior before the floor revision, with a masonry-looking floor.

after.alt: Farmhouse interior after the revision, with honey-coloured wooden floorboards.
